llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Hyperliquid trading-desk helper whose network calls and write actions match its stated purpose, though users should treat its trading authority carefully.

dimensions.detail: It uses Hyperliquid API and SDK examples and environment variables for account/network selection, which is proportionate for a trading workflow but involves sensitive financial account context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no executable install scripts, package hooks, dependency installation, or setup-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Write actions are explicitly limited to an Execution Trader on an approved ticket, with safeguards such as live size reads, slippage bounds, IOC, reduce-only orders, and post-close checks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, credential harvesting, tool modification, memory writes, or privilege escalation instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is narrowly focused on Hyperliquid perp positions, margin, leverage, liquidation checks, and reduce-only closes; these capabilities match the stated trading-desk purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend agents to assist with Hyperliquid account review and approved trading operations. Keep write use limited to trusted operators and approved tickets, verify the selected network and account address, and review any leverage, margin, close, or cancel action before execution.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: The flagged POST to /info sends the configured Hyperliquid account address to the official Hyperliquid API to retrieve clearinghouse state; this is expected for reading positions and margin.
[E1] expected: The flagged meta request goes to the same Hyperliquid API to retrieve market and margin-tier metadata; it is purpose-aligned and does not include secrets.
[E1] expected: The flagged frontendOpenOrders request queries open trigger orders for protection checks; this external API use is disclosed by the skill's trading-risk purpose.
